title: Text Editor Using Linked List
problemStatement: Design a text editor supporting the following operations: addText(text) — Insert text at the cursor position. deleteText(k) — Delete up to k characters to the left of the cursor. cursorLeft(k) — Move the cursor left by at most k positions and return up to the last 10 characters to the left of the cursor. cursorRight(k) — Move the cursor right by at most k positions and return up to the last 10 characters to the left of the cursor. Process a sequence of operations and print the results for query operations.
output: Print the result of every deleteText(), cursorLeft(), and cursorRight() operation.
constraints: 1 <= q <= 2 × 10^5 Total length of inserted text does not exceed 2 × 10^6
